What the data shows

Headline findings from the full dataset. The complete write-up and recommendations are on GitHub.

+113%

Giving more than doubled since 2020

Annual donations rose every year, from $158.2M in 2020 to $337.5M in 2024.

53%

Major donors carry the program

The top 1% of donors (694 people) gave 53% of all dollars, while the median gift is $91.

$330.4M

Alumni Association leads

It is the top designation at 4.6% of revenue. All 27 designations fall between 2.9% and 4.6%, so giving is broadly spread.

$1.53B

Credit card and stock gifts lead

Credit card ($1.53B) and stock ($1.51B) gifts bring in the most, ahead of cash at $1.36B.

Built by Bruno Silva in Power BI (source and .pbix on GitHub). This web version is generated from the same data model: 1,048,575 gift records identified by donor ID only, with no names or contact details.
